notes: Swarm Hood (SHOOD): a fixed-supply plain ERC-20 on Robinhood Chain, implemented in src/SHOODToken.sol as contract SHOODToken. The constructor takes no arguments and mints the whole 1,000,000,000 SHOOD (1e27 minor units) once to its deployer, the launch factory; totalSupply() is a constant and there is no mint path afterwards. No owner, no admin, no pause, no blacklist, no fee, tax or transfer limit, no proxy, no delegatecall, no selfdestruct; every parameter is a compile-time constant and the contract imports nothing. There are no application contracts. The factory distributes the supply: it sends the swarm's 10% through the launch's Merkle distributor, seeds the Uniswap v4 pool (PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951) single-sided with 90% of the supply paired with IMD at 0x5f7bb59365ce557c26dbcaa4ee9d39a4b95b7127, and sends any remainder to remainderTo. pool.fee 12500 is the launch policy's 1.25% fee at which the factory opens the pool. pool.initialPrice is provenance only (the brief quoted 125270724187523965593206900 with SHOOD as currency0); the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei (2500 IMD for the whole supply), totalSupply and the deployed currency order.
